name: boilA_fixh
goal: Take the pot filled with water and place it on the stove.
note:
SKILL GUIDE (practice only). Goal now: put the pot ON the stove cooking surface.
1) navigate_to('stove'); then get_observation() AGAIN (the base frame moved).
2) The stove cooking surface is UP HIGH, about 0.85 m above the base origin: in the post-navigate base frame the target point is roughly T=(0.45, 0.0, 0.85). The stove top is NOT near the floor (z=0.05) -- do not place the pot on the floor.
3) Perceive and grasp the pot: m=segment_sam3_text_prompt(img,'pot'); smap=its best mask (0/1); g,s=plan_grasp(depth,K,smap); if len(g): gp=pose_mat@g[argmax(s)]; p=gp[:3,3]; q=rotm_wxyz(gp[:3,:3]); move_to_joints(solve_ik(p,q)); close_gripper(); move_to_joints(solve_ik(p+[0,0,0.15],[0,0,1,0])).
4) Place on the stove: move_to_joints(solve_ik(T+[0,0,0.20],[0,0,1,0])); move_to_joints(solve_ik(T,[0,0,1,0])); open_gripper(). Lower the pot to the stove-top height ~0.85 m so it rests on the stove.
rotm_wxyz(R): rotation matrix to unit quaternion [w,x,y,z]. Write plain Python only.
